name: zstd
readme_excerpt: Zstandard, or zstd as short version, is a fast lossless compression algorithm, targeting real-time compression scenarios at zlib-level and better compression ratios. It's backed by a very fast entropy stage, provided by Huff0 and FSE library. Zstandard's format is stable and documented in RFC8878. Multiple independent implementations are already available.
